loss.mechanism: add a normalized timing-weighted star-edge attraction (1 - graph_scores) to the unchanged random-walk logsigmoid pair loss
loss.decision: each connected net star contributes graph_weights-normalized attraction, changing embeddings but not the decoder
loss.prediction: critical connected supernodes should co-locate, lowering timing-weighted cut and improving TNS after feasible partitioning
loss.falsifier: if matched cells show no lower timing-weighted cut or TNS worsens, the graph-attraction hypothesis is disproved.
